revenue.rationale: Income statement "Revenue" line; 16 observations through period ending 2026-09-03 (FY2026 133,188M matches periodic.txt). Revenues/SalesRevenueNet not in snapshot. Q4 derived as FY minus 9M YTD covers 14 weeks (53-week FY2026).

operating_income.rationale: Operating income; 16 observations through 2026-09-03 (FY2026 99,340M). Note it is after other operating (income) expense, so not equal to GP - R&D - SG&A.

net_income.rationale: Net income; 16 observations through 2026-09-03 (FY2026 84,969M matches income statement).

diluted_shares.rationale: Weighted-average diluted shares; 16 observations through 2026-09-03 (FY 1,143M). Non-additive: must not be differenced. Caveat: the concepts tool preview shows latest_val 1,000,000, which is an FY-minus-YTD difference (1,143M-1,142M) and not a valid Q4 share count; downstream should not use differenced value.

eps_diluted.rationale: Diluted EPS; 16 observations through 2026-09-03 (FY 74.33). Non-additive; the concepts preview latest_val 32.93 is an FY-minus-YTD difference (74.33-41.40), not reported Q4 EPS, and needs care given 14-week Q4.

cfo.rationale: Operating cash flow; 16 observations through 2026-09-03 (FY2026 89,675M matches).

capex.rationale: Expenditures for PP&E; 16 observations through 2026-09-03 (FY2026 30,712M). PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets absent.

sbc.rationale: Cash-flow add-back (FY2026 1,333M matches cash flow statement); 16 observations through 2026-09-03. Judgment: chose over AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense (1,282M, note disclosure) for consistency with CFO.

cash.rationale: Balance sheet cash and cash equivalents 38,364M at 2026-09-03 matches; 16 observations. Excludes restricted cash (alternative concept 38,391M).

short_term_investments.rationale: Judgment: sum of short-term marketable investments (AvailableForSaleSecuritiesDebtSecuritiesCurrent 5,070M) and long-term marketable investments (AvailableForSaleSecuritiesDebtSecuritiesNoncurrent 30,019M) = 35,089M at 2026-09-03; each has 16 observations through the latest period on the same period ends. The long-term marketable investments are available-for-sale investment-grade fixed income that management counts in 'cash and marketable investments' ($73.45B), so they belong in net cash. Non-marketable equity investments (about $1.30B in other noncurrent assets) stay excluded. Repair of asm-001; round 1 mapped the current portion only (5,070M).

total_debt.rationale: Judgment: sum of balance sheet current debt (DebtCurrent 491M) and long-term debt (LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations 4,688M) = 5,179M at 2026-09-03; each has 16 observations through latest. Catalog first candidate LongTermDebt is STALE/incomplete (14 observations, missing 2026-02-26 and 2026-05-28, last value 2,792M not matching balance sheet), so not used.

assets.rationale: Total assets 195,888M at 2026-09-03 matches balance sheet; 16 observations.
